titles.en: Havoc Condition Manager - Solo Play Expansion

image_type: UI layout renders with sample configurations; not gameplay screenshots

summaries.en: Requires SoloPlay; supports Realms. Select Havoc, Auric/Maelstrom and event conditions, environments and 1–5× spawn multipliers. Fixes duplicate shared-page closing during DMF toggles while preserving native effects and saved configuration.
summaries.zh-CN: 以 SoloPlay 为前提，支持 Realms。分类选择浩劫、金级、大漩涡和活动词条，调整环境及1–5倍刷怪。本版修复 DMF 开关时与高级生成器共用页面的重复关闭，保留原版效果和已保存配置。
summaries.zh-TW: 以 SoloPlay 為前提，支援 Realms。分類選擇浩劫、金級、大漩渦和活動詞條，調整環境及1–5倍刷怪。本版修復 DMF 開關時與高階生成器共用頁面的重複關閉，保留原版效果和已儲存配置。

main_file_description: Requires SoloPlay; supports Realms. Select Havoc, Auric/Maelstrom and event conditions, environments and 1–5× spawn multipliers. Fixes duplicate shared-page closing during DMF toggles while preserving native effects and saved configuration.
